meta.title: Continuous Running + Kettlebell Plan
meta.goal: General fitness and fun — stay ready to run anything from 5K to the half marathon. Train by effort; let RPE win over the watch.
meta.note: A repeating Sun–Sat weekly template. Weeks alternate A and B. Log how each session felt and adjust as life demands.
meta.zonesNote: Paces are estimates built from the assumption in B4. Always let effort/RPE win over the watch on hot, hilly, or tired days.

A.kb: KB A – Hinge & Press (~35'): One-arm swings 4×10 each | Single-leg RDL (one KB) 3×8 each | Double-KB press 4×5 | Renegade row 3×5 each | Turkish get-up 3×2 each | Double farmer carry 4×40s
A.notes: Strength day. Stop each set ~2 reps shy of failure; quality running always wins.

A.details: WU 10' easy jog + drills | 3×8' @ threshold (1' easy jog between) | CD 6' easy
A.notes: Run by effort. Once comfortable, progress by pace (3–5 sec/mi), not volume.

A.details: Easy aerobic run 40' (Zone 2, talk-test pace) | finish with 5×15s strides (relaxed-fast, 45–60s walk/jog between)
A.kb: KB B – Upper & Core (~25'): Halos 3×8 each way | Double-KB press 4×5 | Double-KB bent-over row 4×8 | Turkish get-up 3×2 each | Windmill 2×5 each | Dead bug 3×8 each
A.notes: Strides prime you for tomorrow's quality work.

A.details: WU 10' easy jog + drills | 5×3' @ VO2 effort (~3K–5K race effort) (2' easy jog between) | CD 7' easy
A.notes: Hard but repeatable — last rep ≈ first rep. Jog the recoveries, don't stop.

A.details: No running — kettlebell session only. Moderate legs — stop every set ~2 reps shy of failure.
A.kb: KB C – Squat, Single-Leg & Carry (~35'): Double-KB front squat 4×8 | Rear-foot-elevated split squat (goblet) 3×6 each | Single-leg calf raise 3×12 each | Step-up (stair/low box, double KB) 3×8 each | Rack carry (one KB) 3×45s each | Side plank 3×35s each
A.notes: Keep legs moderate so Friday's strides and Saturday's long run stay fresh.

A.details: Easy aerobic run 35' (Zone 2, talk-test pace) | finish with 5×15s strides (relaxed-fast, 45–60s walk/jog between)
Long run 80' easy (Zone 2). Steady and relaxed — finish feeling you could run 10–15' more.
A.notes: From ~60–75' on, practice fueling: water + roughly 30–60 g carbs/hr.

B.kb: KB A – Hinge & Press (~35'): One-arm swings 4×10 each | Single-leg RDL (one KB) 3×8 each | Double-KB press 4×5 | Renegade row 3×5 each | Turkish get-up 3×2 each | Double farmer carry 4×40s
B.notes: Strength day. Stop each set ~2 reps shy of failure; quality running always wins.

B.details: WU 10' easy jog + drills | 3×8' @ threshold (1' easy jog between) | CD 6' easy
B.notes: Run by effort. Once comfortable, progress by pace (3–5 sec/mi), not volume.

B.kb: KB B – Upper & Core (~25'): Halos 3×8 each way | Double-KB press 4×5 | Double-KB bent-over row 4×8 | Turkish get-up 3×2 each | Windmill 2×5 each | Dead bug 3×8 each
B.notes: Keep it genuinely easy. KB B can be done after the run, at lunch, or split into desk-break blocks.

B.details: WU 15' easy jog + drills | 6×10s hill sprints (walk down, ≥90s recovery; flat accelerations if no hill) | CD 13' easy
B.notes: Quality over quantity: stop if form degrades. Full recovery between reps.

B.details: No running — kettlebell session only. Moderate legs — stop every set ~2 reps shy of failure.

zones.name: Easy – Zone 2
zones.rule: TT pace + 100–150 sec/mi (slower is fine; go by talk test)
zones.frequency: Most of the week (3–4 runs + long run)

zones.name: Short Sprints / Accelerations
zones.purpose: Recruit fast-twitch fibers, running economy, form
zones.rule: Fast and relaxed — roughly mile-race effort or hill sprint
zones.sessions: Hill sprints 6–8×8–10s, flat 6–8×15–20s; 4–5 strides after select easy runs
zones.frequency: Every other week (Wednesday, B weeks) + weekly strides
